name: Light Hunt - Now Playing
author: Light Hunt (lightshunt.com)
description: Shows the song Falcon Player is playing on your free Light Hunt display page, and lets visitors vote for the next song if you turn it on. lightshunt.com/fpp lists exactly what it sends.

privacy.summary: Once paired, sends the song now playing, its artist and time left, the next songs, and the playlist name to lightshunt.com. This appears on your public Light Hunt display page. Unless you switch it off, it also sends a Show doctor summary: each check's name and result and the names it is about, never IP addresses.

sends.what: pairing key, song title and artist, file names, play state, time left, the next songs in the playlist, playlist name, plugin version
sends.why: to show what is playing on your public Light Hunt display page

sends.what: only while song voting is turned on: the sequence and audio file names in the running playlist, the song now playing and its length, and whether the winning song played
sends.why: to show visitors a ballot and play the song they pick next

sends.what: plugin version, then the pairing code and a device secret to check it
sends.why: to link this player to your Light Hunt display

sends.what: your feedback message, an email address only if you type one, plugin, FPP and PHP versions, whether paired, the last send result, reason and time, the last 20 plugin log lines only if you tick the box (home folder names, IP addresses and pairing keys removed), and the pairing key as a sign-in header when paired
sends.why: to send feedback to Light Hunt, only when you press Send on the plugin page

sends.what: only while paired and the Show doctor summary switch is on (it starts on): the time of the check and, for each of five checks, its name, ok/look/fix, a count, and up to 20 sequence, file, playlist or controller names. Never IP addresses.
sends.why: to warn you on lightshunt.com if the show is not ready, 30 minutes before tonight's schedule starts and after you press Run again

collects.what: Light Hunt pairing key and display name, and this player's hardware id (read from Falcon Player, never sent) to notice a copied SD card
pairing code and device secret, while pairing
song now playing and send status, for the plugin page
the last Show doctor results and whether the summary switch is on
process ID of the running poller
log of pairing, unpairing and failed sends, never the key

privacy.remoteAccess: Only while song voting is turned on: when visitors pick a song, the plugin runs Falcon Player's Insert Playlist After Current command on this player to play that song next. Light Hunt can choose only a song from the running playlist, and nothing else.

systemChanges.what: Runs one background PHP process (the poller) while FPP is running; stops it when FPP stops

privacy.other: Like FPP's own pages, the plugin's web routes ask for no password: anyone who can open this FPP's web pages can start pairing or unpair it and can see the paired display's name. Pairing is refused while already paired. Reads FPP's local API at 127.0.0.1 (status, media tags and schedule). Show doctor reads FPP's channel output, playlist and schedule files, the first bytes of each .fseq, disk space, CPU temperature, vcgencmd get_throttled and timedatectl, and pings each controller address on your network once per check. Its channel layout check reads config/model-overlays.json in your browser and sends nothing. Sends nothing until you pair, apart from feedback you press Send on. The key file is mode 0600. Unpair removes the key from this device; uninstalling removes the key, status file and log.
